proofOfCompleteness.rawOcrWords: raw/<run>/<opaqueItemId>.words.jsonl carries one record per OcrWord for every pass, and the acquisition asserts emittedWordCount === debug.passes[i].words.length for every pass. Any inequality halts with RAW_EVIDENCE_TRUNCATED. No sampleWords cap, no first-25 cap and no 120-character text truncation is applied, because the evidence is read from the debug object returned by a direct extractLabelEvidenceDetailed call rather than from the capped CaseReport projection.
proofOfCompleteness.candidateDecisions: raw/<run>/<opaqueItemId>.candidates.jsonl carries one record per BrandCandidateDiagnostic, kept AND rejected, each with the complete PR #220 filterChecks and activeRejectionReasons. The acquisition asserts emittedCandidateCount === brandDiagnostics.candidates.length read before any projection, that ordinals are contiguous from 0 and unique, and that stable candidate IDs are unique within the case. Halts with CANDIDATE_EVIDENCE_TRUNCATED, CANDIDATE_ID_COLLISION or COMPLETE_DIAGNOSTICS_ABSENT.

layout.raw/<run>/<opaqueItemId>.words.jsonl: one record per OCR word, in original order, across every pass
layout.raw/<run>/<opaqueItemId>.lines.jsonl: one record per reconstructed Brand line, in emitted order
layout.raw/<run>/<opaqueItemId>.candidates.json: one record per Brand candidate decision, kept and rejected, with complete PR #220 filter diagnostics and the complete evidence record schema in candidate-decision-contract.json
layout.raw/<run>/<opaqueItemId>.selection.json: final selected value, authority state, abstention reason, complete ranked order

immutabilityRule: After a run's raw-evidence-manifest.sha256 is written, no file under raw/<run>/ is rewritten, reformatted or pretty-printed. JSONL is emitted in final form and is excluded from prettier via .prettierignore.
truthBearingFieldsAbsentByConstruction: every key in the canonical inventory asset; see forbiddenEvidenceKeyInventory for the path and digest. The list is not restated here.

truthIsolationAssertion.inBoundaryKeyAndFileScan: Inside the isolated boundary the acquisition scans every emitted file for the forbidden evidence KEY inventory, and for unexpected mounted or emitted files. Halt: TRUTH_ISOLATION_FAILURE.
truthIsolationAssertion.postSealHistoricalValueScan: AFTER both raw manifests are sealed, a separate read-only verifier — which holds the historical case-ID and fixture-path inventory the runtime never receives — scans the frozen bytes for those VALUES. Halt: TRUTH_ISOLATION_FAILURE.
truthIsolationAssertion.correctionOfPriorClaim: An earlier revision said historical IDs and paths were scanned before each manifest was written. The isolated runtime cannot do that: it does not hold the inventory, and handing it over would be the leak. The two scans are distinct in scope, actor and timing.

knownGapsCarriedFromTheContracts: word baseline geometry — not present on OcrWord
block, paragraph and line identifiers — not present on OcrWord
constituent word IDs per reconstructed line — not emitted by BrandLineDiagnostic
resolvedGap: Every individual filter check and every active rejection reason per candidate, previously unavailable, is supplied by merged PR #220.
completeDiagnosticsSource: the diagnosticSelection candidate array produced by selectBrandObservationWithCompleteFilterDiagnostics over the exact production pass set, NOT debug.finalSelections. See brand-diagnostic-parity-contract.json.

forbiddenEvidenceKeyInventory.canonicalFormatting: a bare JSON array of the key names in authoritative order, no whitespace, one terminal newline
forbiddenEvidenceKeyInventory.keysNotRestatedHereWhy: Amendment 6 declared the asset authoritative and then copied the array into four contracts and a test, which is four more places to drift. Operative contracts reference the path and hash; the runtime, the freeze script, the bundle scanner and the consistency test all READ the asset.
forbiddenEvidenceKeyInventory.fieldNamesVersusValues: These are FIELD NAMES, prohibited inside acquisition output. The historical identifier and fixture-path VALUES are checked after sealing by the read-only identity-leak verifier, which holds an inventory the isolated runtime never receives.
forbiddenEvidenceKeyInventory.governsEveryEmittedFile: pass records, candidate records, selection records, item-level failure records, count records, manifests and provenance records alike

supportProvenanceLevel.candidateRecordSupportPassIds: the support IDs exposed on the PUBLIC BrandCandidateDiagnostic — that is, the support the candidate had BEFORE any later merge
supportProvenanceLevel.candidateProvenance: the PUBLIC diagnostic provenance, likewise pre-merge
supportProvenanceLevel.whyPreMerge: Production merges support-pass information during candidate deduplication (dedupeBestCandidates -> mergeCandidateSupport, field-selection.ts:466, 2175-2195). The public diagnostic objects are constructed before that, and the only values written back to them afterwards are score, ranking and decision. supportPassIds is never written back.
supportProvenanceLevel.finalSelectionSupportingPassIds: persisted SEPARATELY from FieldSelection.supportingPassIds for the selected observation, where the post-merge value IS exposed

completePostDeduplicationMergedSupportFo.why: The merged support set exists only on the internal Candidate objects inside the ranked array. It is not written back to the public diagnostics and is not otherwise exposed.
completePostDeduplicationMergedSupportFo.notReconstructedWhy: Recomputing the merge outside production would be a second implementation of deduplication, and labelling its output as production's merged support would misstate what the pipeline produced.
completePostDeduplicationMergedSupportFo.wouldRequire: a production change to expose it, which this amendment forbids

supportProvenanceLevel.doNotCall: the candidate-record supportPassIds the final post-deduplication support set for every ranked candidate

stage1ExecutionStatus: The Stage 1 trusted freeze/staging generator and its temporary reproducibility mode have run. No Stage 2 Job A workflow, truth-free preparation artifact, runtime-bundle build, discovery, execute mode or governed 115-case acquisition OCR has run.

candidateEmissionApi.firstArgument: the frozen ExtractionInput. NOT ExtractionDebug, NOT a FieldSelection, NOT a candidate array.
candidateEmissionApi.returnsOnFailure: the extractor's typed ExtractionError, unchanged, with no diagnostic selection and no candidate record
candidateEmissionApi.opaqueIdentitySource: input.artifactRef — there is no second identifier that could disagree with it
internalSteps: validate input.artifactRef matches ^item-\\d{4}$, before any extractor invocation
return the extractor's typed failure unchanged when it returns !ok
keep DetailedExtractionResult and ExtractionDebug private until that call succeeds
reconstruct the exact Brand pass set: primary OBSERVED ? [debug.passes[0]] : debug.passes
perform full-object parity internally against debug.finalSelections.brand
finalize the complete internally derived candidate population
return the original detailed result, the diagnostic selection and the candidate records together
supersededRoutes: a bare candidate array (Amendment 8 and earlier)
a caller-supplied FieldSelection (Amendment 9): a filtered population could be wrapped in a freshly constructed selection
a caller-supplied ExtractionDebug (Amendment 10): a helper could filter or reorder the passes and reconstruct matching primary and final selections
candidateEmissionApi.whyExtractorOwned: Each earlier signature closed the route it named and left an adjacent one open. Owning the extractor call removes the class: there is no caller-supplied evidence at all, and the runner never holds an intermediate it could alter.
candidateEmissionApi.runtimeExportSurfaceVerifiedBy: importing the module namespace and inspecting its actual runtime own keys, not a source regex

haltCodes.MALFORMED_ARTIFACT_REF: input.artifactRef does not match ^item-\\d{4}$; raised before the extractor is invoked
haltCodes.DEBUG_PASSES_ABSENT: the extractor's debug carries no ordered pass array
haltCodes.BRAND_DIAGNOSTIC_SELECTION_PARITY_FAILUR: the internally derived selection differs from debug.finalSelections.brand once only the two complete-diagnostics fields are removed
haltCodes.COMPLETE_DIAGNOSTICS_ABSENT: the internally derived selection carries no brandDiagnostics.candidates array
haltCodes.CANDIDATE_EVIDENCE_TRUNCATED: the emitted record count does not equal the internally derived diagnostic candidate count
haltCodes.RANKED_MEMBERSHIP_INCONSISTENT: decision, ranking and rankedPosition are mutually inconsistent, or a kept population retains no ranked survivor
haltCodes.RANKED_POSITION_PARITY_FAILURE: ranked positions are not unique or contiguous, or there is not exactly one selected candidate

producedBy.note: Every per-item file below is serialized INSIDE acquireProductionBrandEvidence and returned as a sealed byte descriptor. The runner writes the complete package and never serializes, filters, projects, reorders or parses evidence itself.
